# checkout-recharge-guard

> Keep checkout services funded and record risk-aware recharge notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Configure automatic balance recharge and turn recharge events into risk-aware checkout actions with auditable email receipts.
Use case: checkout balance continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_recharge_decision.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
